rows.commentary: 0.1: Samantha Bates begins the attack, floating it up to Charli Knott who pushes it cleanly toward backward point for a single.
0.2: Samantha Bates keeps it full, turning Grace Harris loose to collect a single out in the deep mid-wicket region.
0.3: Samantha Bates drops it into the arc, and Charli Knott punishes it with a fierce sweep all the way to the deep mid-wicket boundary for four.
0.4: No run for Charli Knott off Samantha Bates.
0.5: Dot ball from Samantha Bates to Charli Knott.
0.6: Samantha Bates darts this one in, nudged sharply by Charli Knott toward point to pinch a brisk single.
1.1: Lauren Bell charges in from the other end, testing Charli Knott who guides it away to deep backward point for a comfortable run.
13.2: Georgia Voll strikes as Grace Harris departs for a blazing 58 after picking out Darlington in the field.
13.3: No run for Yastika Bhatia off Georgia Voll.
13.4: Georgia Voll drops her pace and Yastika Bhatia nudges it away toward long-on for a single.
13.5: Georgia Voll pushes it through and Redmayne rotates the strike with a single down to long-on.
13.6: Georgia Voll claims a caught-and-bowled dismissal as Yastika Bhatia chips it straight back to the bowler for just 1.
Georgia Voll strikes twice in the over, claiming two quick wickets to stun the batting side!
14.1: Nadine de Klerk slides one in and Redmayne collects a single out at long-on.
14.2: Dot ball from Nadine de Klerk to Orla Prendergast.
14.3: Nadine de Klerk strays slightly and Orla Prendergast deftly glides it away to the fine leg boundary for four.
14.4: Dot ball from Nadine de Klerk to Orla Prendergast.
14.5: Nadine de Klerk offers width and Orla Prendergast punishes it aggressively through deep extra cover for four runs.
14.6: Dot ball from Nadine de Klerk to Orla Prendergast.
15.1: Jemma Barsby floats it up and Redmayne works it down to long-on for a comfortable single.
15.2: Jemma Barsby keeps it full, allowing Orla Prendergast to pierce the gap and collect a single towards long-off.
15.3: Jemma Barsby bowls into the surface and Redmayne steers it out toward extra cover for one run.
15.4: Jemma Barsby overpitches and Orla Prendergast drills it powerfully into the deep extra cover region for four.
15.5: Jemma Barsby is worked away to mid-on by Orla Prendergast for a quick single to rotate the strike.
